findings: K1 loads actual (10000,1) return packets from K1 searches, intersects the sole returned ID with gt[:,:1], and divides by n. It cannot count GT1 hidden in K100 returns.

K100 separately loads actual (10000,100) packets, requires unique valid return IDs and unique exact GT100 IDs, scores exact set intersections, and independently compares integer hit counts against per-GT-member membership sums.

The frozen job contract requires n=10000, K_values=[1,100], and exact L=[200,400,800,1000,1200]. Two combined jobs produce 60 point records, 60 paired comparison records, and 200000 aligned M5/GT query-by-K-by-L records. Root independently reported the two frozen jobs are exactly the intended WebVid and Yandex jobs.

The benchmark_v2 timing loop appends each method's timings in round order 0,1,2 at the same fixed K/L. evaluate_v2 compares matching array positions, computes each round's QPS ratio, and then takes the ratio median; it does not divide independently selected QPS medians.

paired_ci_pp groups exact observed integer per-query delta_hits. Multinomial(n, empirical class frequencies) gives the same distribution of class totals as ordinary paired row bootstrap; the aggregate mean uses denominator n*K and is explicitly descriptive, with fixed seed and 2000 repetitions.

All Recall and returned-route comparisons use full 10000 rows. NDC arrays and stats use exactly the predetermined 256 rows, verified against persisted floor(i*9999/255) audit IDs, and all reported count fields are explicitly named or scoped as sampled.

The GT/M5 full route-ID packet and full profile-distance words must match. Sampled route counts must match. Sampled M5 graph-score excess must equal sampled post_dots; those post dots are already included in graph_ndc.

The evaluator requires the v2 complete-native status, 90 formal wall records per dataset for three repetitions, actual saved job equality, thread/CPU receipts, count-parity sample scope, full-return scope, and the full-10000 M5 linear merge receipt. It checks recorded packet shapes, ID domains, padding, valid output uniqueness, positive finite timing values, and query/GT/table checksum identities before writing metrics.

Plotting requires a completed 60-point metrics status and uses the saved full-test Recall values and complete-wall QPS medians/min-max ranges. It only links measured points; it neither searches nor interpolates for conclusions.

The default plotting metrics path remains the v1-compatible analysis/metrics.json. Root's explicit v2 command supplies --metrics analysis_v2/metrics.json --out figures_v2, so the current authorized workflow is consistent and no source change is needed.
report_boundaries: SOURCE-only. The reviewer did not execute either script or load GT/raw/scored arrays, and does not certify actual completion, numerical results, or plotting appearance.
Upstream native word/count/merge PASS fields are validated as receipts by analysis. This source review is not an independent rerun of native verification.
Each timed result packet was destroyed; only saved untimed outputs supply Recall scoring, and same-body execution supplies timing. Do not claim per-timed-round output bit checks.
Sampled NDC/statistics are not full-batch counts or means; do not extrapolate their totals to 10000 rows.
graph_ndc already includes M5 post scoring. total_ndc=route_ndc+graph_ndc; post_dots remains a subset disclosure.
2000 descriptive query bootstrap repetitions do not constitute a quality gate, population guarantee, or independent test source.
Public test exposure is disclosed. The scripts keep new_training=false, quality_screen_gate_used=false, and default_replacement_decided=false.
The final metrics source_sha256 records inputs and actual saved result packets. Code/model/kernel/build identities are additionally tracked by the experiment freeze/build/source-review records.

Matrix uniqueness and dataset identities are guaranteed by the two root-frozen intended jobs in this scoped run; the source's length checks alone should not be advertised as a generic malformed-job uniqueness proof.
